question: In India, the Executive power of the state is vested in ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Governor.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Governor** is the **head of the state **and holds the **executive power** in India.
 
• The **Council of Ministers** is a body of advisors to the Governor, who assist in the exercise of **executive powers.**
 
• The **Chief Justice of High Court** is a** judicial **authority and **does not hold** executive powers.
 
• The Chief Minister is the head of the** elected governmen**t in a state and exercises **executive powers **within the state, but not at the **national level.**
 
• The Governor is** appointed **by the **President of India** and holds office for a term of **five years,** unless removed earlier.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Council of Ministers: **The Council of Ministers is a **body of advisors** to the Governor, led by the **Chief Minister.**

 
 
• It is responsible for the **administration of the state **and **advises** the Governor on matters related to governance.
 
 
 
• **Chief Justice of High Court:** The Chief Justice of High Court is the **head of the judiciary** in a state and is responsible for the** administration of justice** in the state.
 
• **Chief Minister**: The Chief Minister is the **head of the elected government **in a state and is responsible for the administration of the state.
 
 
• The Chief Minister is appointed by the** Governor **and **holds office **during the pleasure of the Governor.
 
 
 
• **Executive Power:** The executive power of the state refers to the power to **enforce laws and administer the government**.
 
 
• It is vested in the** Governor** in India.
